fact: The Liberian Investigator reports that in June 2023 the NIR modified its system to assign unique identification numbers to children under six, in a programme now called 'Enrolment at Birth', with a pilot in Montserrado, Grand Bassa and Gbarpolu.
The NIR launched Enrolment at Birth on 16 September 2023 to enrol over 500,000 children aged 0-5 into the National Childbirth Enrolment System, which is still being developed.
